name: AetherBuilder
changelog: Fix: Critical api.php parse error (missing closing brace) that caused HTTP 500 on all API requests including media library and uploads on shared hosting (InfinityFree / Apache / PHP)
Fix: Media Library now fully loads and displays files on hosted PHP environments (was broken from v2.9.1)
Fix: File uploads now succeed on shared hosting — removed custom X-Admin-Token header from upload fetch to prevent CORS OPTIONS preflight blocks
Fix: PHP 8.4 compatibility in list_assets — safe stat() access with @stat() and fallback filesize()/filemtime() to prevent fatal TypeErrors
Fix: Directory permissions set to 0777 for assets/uploads, data, and data/revisions ensuring PHP move_uploaded_file succeeds on shared hosts

Fix: Removed duplicate API action blocks (get_dev_auth, save_dev_auth, verify_dev_session, get_templates, save_templates, get_store_feed_config, save_store_feed_config) from api.php that caused redundant request processing
Fix: Restored data/store_feed.json that was wiped to 0 bytes by Developer Hub push bug
Fix: Restored data/templates.json that was wiped to empty [] by Developer Hub push bug
Fix: Developer Hub core push now guards against pushing empty templates.json to GitHub
Fix: Developer Hub push commit message now uses dynamic APP_VERSION instead of hardcoded v2.9.0
New: Add-On Studio wizard fully mobile-friendly — prop rows reflow to 2-column card layout, tab bar scrolls horizontally, footer buttons stack vertically, meta header wraps on small screens
New: Customizable Splash Screen & Pre-loader Settings in Site Settings (⚙️) — full control over loading title, sub-caption, toggle visibility, and live mini-preview
Fix: Resolved black screen bug in Admin Studio & Public View caused by loader z-index conflicts; initial loader auto-dismisses immediately
Fix: Add Section modal real-time search & filter with instant pill tabs
New: Mobile-friendly admin studio with slide-over drawer sidebar
New: Custom Live Chat Add-on (Tawk.to, Crisp, WhatsApp float, custom embed)
New: Contact & Hire Me Add-on (EmailJS, Viber, WhatsApp, Phone)
New: Smart non-destructive addon merger on updates
